title: Mr Power
html_source: Jack Power, fictional, is attached to the offices of the Royal Irish Constabulary in Dublin Castle, “semi-military police” (Gladstone). Modeled after Scotland Yard, its members armed and charged with suppressing Irish political dissidents and thus with the maintenance of British overlordship in Ireland, its functions were much more political than Scotland Yard.
